source_title: open-pencil/open-pencil: AI-native design editor. Open-source Figma alternative. - GitHub
source_excerpt:
Open-source design editor. Opens .fig and .pen design files, includes built-in AI, and ships as a programmable toolkit with a headless Vue SDK for building custom editors.
Status: Active development. Usable today, with some rough edges as features evolve.
Try it online → · Download · Documentation · Roadmap · llms.txt
Or download from the releases page , or use the web app — no install needed.
Requires macOS 13 or later with current Safari updates, Windows 10 or later, or Linux with WebKitGTK 2.40+; the web app needs Chrome 111, Edge 111, Firefox 128, or Safari 16.4 or later. See system requirements .
Official builds send one anonymous ping a day and share usage stats only if you agree. The privacy page lists every field, everything else the app sends, and how to turn it off.
Opens .fig and .pen files — read and write native Figma files, open supported Pencil documents from the app or OS file browser, copy & paste nodes between apps
AI builds designs — describe what you want in chat, 100+ tools create and modify nodes. Bring your own key for the major providers or any compatible endpoint
Fully programmable — headless CLI, XPath queries, Figma Plugin API plus an openpencil API via eval , MCP server for AI agents, and desktop agent integrations for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and Pi
Lint, convert, and extract tokens — inspect documents, lint naming/layout/accessibility, convert between supported formats, analyze colors/typography/spacing/clusters, and extract design tokens
Components and variants — create reusable components, group variants into component sets, insert local assets as instances, and switch variants from the inspector
Working controls — give a component a Reka UI behaviour (switch, slider, tabs, text field, …) and preview it live over the canvas, with real inputs, focus, and keyboard
Image vectorization — convert image layers into editable vector layers with Recraft or fal.ai
Design-to-code export — export selections as JSX/Tailwind, generate token outputs, and map designs into component-oriented code workflows
Vue SDK for custom editors — headless components and composables for embedding OpenPencil into other apps or building workflow-specific editing surfaces. Read the SDK docs →
Real-time collaboration — share a peer-to-peer room over WebRTC with no server or account, or edit Cloud documents together. Cursors, presence, follow mode, voice calls
Optional Cloud — keep documents on your team's own OpenPencil Cloud server, or on the hosted service once it opens, and share them by invitation
Auto layout & CSS Grid — flex and grid layout via Yoga WASM, with gap, padding, alignment, track sizing
~15 MB desktop app — Tauri v2 for macOS, Windows, Linux. Also runs in the browser as a PWA

Omit the file argument and the CLI works on the document open in the editor:
Every command supports --json . See the CLI reference for all commands and options.
Press ⌘ J ( Ctrl J on Windows and Linux) to open the AI assistant. It has 100+ tools that can create shapes, set fills and strokes, manage auto-layout, work with components and variables, run boolean operations, analyze design tokens, and export assets. Bring your own API key for OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google AI, DeepSeek, Z.ai, MiniMax, or compatible endpoints. No backend, no account.
Not every provider works in the browser, and not every model streams tool calls correctly. See BYOK provider & model compatibility for measured results — contributions welcome.
Use Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, or Pi as the design agent in the chat panel. It runs with your own subscription and reaches the canvas through the editor's MCP server. Requires the desktop app.
Install the agent's ACP program and @open-pencil/mcp , then open Settings → Models → Run guided setup . It checks that both are installed, signs the agent in, and confirms a session reaches OpenPencil's tools. Pi runs through the @open-pencil/harness companion, which guided setup installs with one click. See Coding agents for each agent's install command.
Connect Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP client to inspect, modify, and export design documents headlessly. Full docs →
Set OPENPENCIL_MCP_ROOT to limit file access to one directory; it defaults to the current working directory.
Teach your AI coding agent to use OpenPencil — inspect designs, export assets, analyze tokens, modify .fig files:
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, and any agent that supports skills .
For documentation-aware agents, the docs site publishes llms.txt , llms-full.txt , and per-page Markdown files generated from the VitePress docs.
Share a link to co-edit in real time. No server, no account — peers connect directly via WebRTC.
Click the share button in the top-right panel
Share the generated link ( app.openpencil.dev/rooms/ )
Collaborators see your cursor, selection, and edits in real time
Click a peer's avatar to follow their viewport
Click the headphones beside the avatars to start or join the room's voice call
Figma is a closed platform that resists programmatic access: its MCP server is read-only, and automation outside the Plugin API breaks when it ships a point release. Your design files are in a proprietary binary format that only its software can fully read.
OpenPencil is the alternative: open source (MIT), local-first, reads .fig files natively, and every operation is scriptable.
See the roadmap for product direction and current Figma compatibility gaps.
Discord — chat, quick questions, and showing a problem live
GitHub Discussions — Q&A for help, Ideas for feature proposals, Show and tell for what you built; maintainers post Announcements there
Issues — reproducible bugs; report security problems through a private advisory
CONTRIBUTING.md covers setup, quality gates, pull requests, and commits. AGENTS.md maps the repository and links the guide inside each package. Desktop builds need Rust and the Tauri v2 prerequisites ; run bun run tauri build .
